The '''Gulvitch system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Gulvitch]].
